plan: A very mobile monk jungler who leaps onto a target and kicks it into the middle of his team.
aSurveiller: His R (Dragon's Rage). He can kick you towards his team: don't stand alone in front of your allies.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: his Q stops on the first enemy hit.
Keep an escape spell for after his R: once kicked, you need to get away fast.
He is mostly strong early: take advantage of the late game, when his impact drops.
forces: Very mobile thanks to his Q and his W.
His R can kick a target into the middle of his team.
Very strong in the early game.
faiblesses: Loses power in the late game.
Relies on his Q to reach his target.
Low damage if he falls behind.

sorts.P: After a spell, his next 2 attacks are faster.
sorts.Q: Wave that marks the first enemy; he can then dash to it.
sorts.W: Dashes to an ally with a shield for both.
sorts.E: Slams the ground and reveals, then slows enemies hit.
sorts.R: Kick that knocks the target back and knocks up those it hits.

momentFort: Strong from level 3: he ganks and fights at the Scuttle Crab very early. If he isn't ahead after 15 minutes, he loses impact.
